info.name: Generated renewal certificates - signing, eligibility, and PDF preview
info.description: Real external renewal baseline plus own ADMIN signing-profile CRUD, bounded PNG/JPEG normalization, private R2 reads, immutable replacement history, ownership/category bypass prevention, and role gates. Fixtures are created here; R2 cleanup belongs to the runner journal. Super-admin competent-person signature management, ordinary-admin category assignment/clearing, private image version history, direct role/field bypasses, restricted/unrestricted signer eligibility, and status changes after selection. Stateless gopdf PDF previews, XX numbering, private signed snapshots, account/certificate/purpose bindings, changed sources and eligibility, role gates, non-expiring tests, and no publication before approval. Real token expiry is covered in Go through the HTTP endpoint.
